answer: The strongest concrete reason is factor precision: “3.4%” is evidently a rounded presentation of the underlying index adjustment, while the official threshold was calculated using a more precise CPI index ratio (or an officially specified index calculation) before whole-dollar rounding. The official tier-A-implied increase is 3.3573251777%, not exactly 3.4%.
